facts.fact: The CSA enforces the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038), directing and fining the Office of the Registrar of Companies and Purpleline Solutions for non-compliance.

The CSA states the Office of the Registrar of Companies is an institution designated as Critical Information Infrastructure, and on 15 June 2026 directed it to engage a Tier 1 licensed cybersecurity service provider.
